about_the_game:
Enter a delightful world filled with lovely birds and breathtaking landscapes. Your goal is to seek out adorable birds and matching items hidden within beautifully designed scenes. It's a unique twist on hidden object games where you'll hone your observation skills by finding hidden pairs.

As you play, gather shimmering water drops and fluttering butterflies, adding to the serene atmosphere. The game features calming music and a serene atmosphere designed to soothe your soul and provide a truly relaxing escape.

Hidden Pairs 3: Lovely Birds offers a unique pair-matching puzzle experience that will test your observation skills and keep you engaged for hours. It's the perfect blend of relaxation and challenge, making it an ideal game for anyone looking to unwind and sharpen their mind.

Key features:

A brand new hidden object game with 150+ levels to solve

Includes 10 new and unique pair-matching mini-games!

Replayable hidden object puzzles for endless fun

Immerse yourself in peaceful atmospheres and calming music

Collect Flower Cards and save adorable birds!

Suitable for players of all ages, from kids to adults
